name: dimloglines
description: dim log lines specified by regular expressions in the code

dimloglines.opacity.description: value between 0 and 1 used for the opacity for the dimmed log lines

dimloglines.regExps.description: fallback regular expressions to identify log lines when detectionMode is regex or both

dimloglines.detectionMode.description: log detection strategy: built-in scanner, regular expressions, or both

dimloglines.scanMode.description: scan only the visible editor window or the full document

dimloglines.visibleContextLines.description: number of lines before and after the visible editor range to include when scanMode is visible

dimloglines.loggerNames.description: logger object names used by the built-in scanner

dimloglines.logMethods.description: logger method names used by the built-in scanner

dimloglines.methodSuffixes.description: method suffixes accepted by the built-in scanner, such as f and ln

dimloglines.logFunctions.description: function or macro names used by the built-in scanner

dimloglines.caseInsensitiveMethods.description: match logger methods case-insensitively in the built-in scanner

dimloglines.maxFileSizeKb.description: maximum document size in KB to scan for dimmed log lines

dimloglines.maxMatches.description: maximum number of matched ranges to decorate in one document

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
